title: Relationship data: filtering, multi-step query data, multi-hop questions
keyFindings: Relationship data is the suite's native RAG value proposition, not an add-on: Astrographer's reference graph (reference→fact, §4.2.1/§4.2.3) and Zodiac's pre-graphed dependency data (§4.2) are already pinned relationship structures that pure vector retrieval cannot express.

Astrographer's ragQuery already has an undefined `filters?` parameter (§4.3.2) — the low-risk, additive home for relationship-aware filtering (by node kind, relationship/edge type, reference target, wiki), directly implementing the source talk's 'person with comment access' filtering example.

Multi-hop over Astrographer's reference graph is the MUST-HAVE topological resolution already recommended in dag-rag-research-notes.md §4: resolving a reference requires resolving its target fact first, a dependency-ordered traversal that must respect the §4.2.3 consistency invariant (FRESH/RESOLVED vs BROKEN/STALE).

Zodiac's graph mode (§4.3.2) already returns pre-graphed subgraphs; transitive dependency-closure traversal (multi-hop) and relationship-type filtering (depends_on vs dev_depends_on) are proposed SHOULD extensions to §4.3.1/§4.3.2 and the zodiac_query MCP tool.
Incanter's graph is a token-transition multigraph (§4.4), not a semantic relationship graph — relationship data belongs at the Astrographer/Zodiac layer, not inside Incanter's token graph.

D4 parity requires relationship filtering + multi-hop on both GUI and MCP (rag_query/rag_stream, zodiac_query); cross-instance multi-hop via Solomon is NICE-TO-HAVE/PARKED, and Mystery's topic→reference relationship model is PARKED until its spec exists.
summary: Relationship data — filtering by relationship/edge type, multi-step query data, and multi-hop question answering — is the suite's native Graph RAG value proposition, and the relationship substrate (Astrographer's reference graph, Zodiac's pre-graphed dependency data) is already pinned in the contracts. The MUST items are low-risk, additive spec changes: define relationship-aware filtering on Astrographer's ragQuery `filters` param (§4.3.2), add topological reference→fact multi-hop resolution (§4.2.3), and expose both through GUI + MCP (D4). Zodiac's graph mode gains transitive multi-hop and relationship-type filtering as SHOULD items; cross-instance multi-hop (Solomon) and Mystery's topic→reference model are PARKED until the local foundation lands.
